routes.name: Independent review of the nongraded strict obstruction

C9000195.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 195 (A counterexample to the small Cohen–Macaulay module conjecture.; papers: A Complete Local Domain without a Small Cohen–Macaulay Module; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/195.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_NG.statement: A finite nonzero MCM module over the completed surface cone forces K_X^2-2c_2(X)<6H^2, hence verifies thm:obstruction and excludes its equality boundary.
C_NG.remaining: Independent review of the complete geometric proof, cited propositions, statement fidelity, significance and novelty; no Reviewer acceptance is asserted.

C_NG_MODEL.statement: The actual arbitrary nongraded module gives regular Cartier models and an extension with torsion-free positive-rank restriction; its finite pushforward is trivial off D.
C_NG_MODEL.remaining: Review Section 1 and external assumptions S1-S6,S10-S12; in particular the depth argument for restriction and the completed-cone identifications.

C_NG_BALANCE.statement: Modifying whenever HN width is at least one terminates with width strictly less than one, preserving torsion-freeness of both sheaves and the same punctured bundle.
C_NG_BALANCE.remaining: Review the Cartier Tor sequence, all repeated hypotheses, and the equality-width case in Section 2.

C_NG_LATTICE.statement: Every punctured-trivial torsion-free lattice on V has actual restriction F with v(F)>=0; torsion-bearing quotient layers are included and F=f_*P after modification.
C_NG_LATTICE.remaining: Review G_0(D) additivity, the conormal sign, global-generation degree bound with torsion, and the affine finite-pushforward restriction identity.

C_NG_FACTOR.statement: Every torsion-free semistable factor satisfies the RR/Bogomolov/Hodge upper bound with the correct common slope shift.
C_NG_FACTOR.remaining: Review Section 4, local-free-resolution extension to coherent sheaves, and assumptions S5,S7-S9, without treating the finite projection as smooth.

C_NG_ALG.statement: All-length layer positivity, arbitrary-weight variance, termination potential, RR identities, mixture identity and strict final assembly hold universally.
C_NG_ALG.remaining: The current formal statement earned closed_kernel with Lean 4.31.0, exit_code=0 and proof_holes=[], including factor_upper_bound and full_numeric_obstruction. This graph stays open until independent statement-fidelity review; no geometric claim is kernel-closed.
